name: CapsLock Notifier
description: .NET Fw 4.7 WinForms — CapsLock / NumLock / ScrollLock bildirimleri (tray app)

steps.run: if not exist "CapsLockChecker\bin\Release\CapsLockChecker.exe" ( echo [X] Build edilmemis - once 'Build' aksiyonunu calistirin & exit /b 1 )

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do "%i" CapsLockChecker.sln /p:Configuration=Release /v:minimal /nologo

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do "%i" CapsLockChecker.sln /p:Configuration=Debug /v:minimal /nologo

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do "%i" CapsLockChecker.sln /t:Restore /v:minimal /nologo

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do "%i" CapsLockChecker.sln /p:Configuration=Release /v:minimal /nologo

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do "%i" CapsLockChecker.sln /t:Restore /v:minimal /nologo
if exist "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" (echo [OK] vswhere bulundu) else (echo [X] vswhere yok - Visual Studio veya Build Tools gerekli)

for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %i in (`"%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe`) do echo [OK] msbuild: %i

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$v = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NET Framework Setup\NDP\v4\Full' -Name Release -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Release; if ($v -ge 460798) { Write-Host '[OK] .NET Fw 4.7.2+ kurulu (release='$v')' } else { Write-Host '[X] .NET Fw 4.7.2+ yok' }"
if exist "CapsLockChecker\bin\Release" ( explorer "CapsLockChecker\bin\Release" ) else ( echo [X] Once build alin )
